title: Nested Control Constructs
objectives: Understand nested loop execution and iteration multiplication
Work with 2D grids and coordinate systems
Use flag variables to break from nested loops
Apply nested loops to real-world problems
description: Master nested loops and complex control structures. Learn 2D grids, time complexity (O(n²)), and real-world pattern generation techniques. Build multiplication tables and coordinate systems!
